# NHSF (UK) Schools

> Information guide for UK schools, students aged 13 to 18, and families. NHSF (UK) Schools launched in 2024 as part of the National Hindu Students' Forum (UK), founded in 1991.

The guide explains how to start or strengthen a Hindu Society at school, what societies do, and how they connect to university chapters. The vision is: Protect, Preserve, Practice and Promote Hindu Dharma.

## Pages

- [Schools information guide](index.html): about NHSF (UK) Schools, purpose, Hindu societies, Hindu Horizons, Navratri 2026, UK maps, questions and contact
- [Privacy policy](privacy-policy.html): how NHSF (UK) handles personal data for the Schools programme

## Hindu Horizons

Online discussion series hosted by the NHSF (UK) School Team and led by the Sanskaar team, for young people typically aged 11 to 18.

## Navratri 2026

School societies are welcome with university chapters. South Zone Navratri is not taking place.

- North Zone: Wednesday 21 October 2026, 6pm–12am, Wythenshawe Forum, Manchester, M22 5RX
- Central Zone: Wednesday 28 October 2026, 6pm–11pm, Shree Prajapati Hall, Leicester, LE4 6BY
- London Zone: Friday 23 October 2026, 6pm–10:30pm, Byron Hall, Harrow, HA3 5BD

## Trust

Every member of the NHSF (UK) Schools team for 2026/27 holds a valid DBS check.
